messages:
Ravi Patel: Heads-up: cloud vendor will deprecate eu-central-1 next quarter. we need an operator-safe evacuation plan that respects EU-only residency. quick brainstorm?
Mae Chen: We should do staged evacuations + a small canary. key constraints: EU_ONLY tenants cannot be served from non-EU regions ever; exports + deletion attestations are required if they refuse move.
Ravi Patel: Agreed. proposed operator flow (short): preflight -> snapshot -> transfer -> validate -> cutover -> retention-lock -> delete-on-legal-ok. who owns runbook?
Mae Chen: I'll draft the runbook. include a canary cohort (3 tenants), parity checks (row counts + sha256 manifests), and rollback gates (checksum mismatch, p95 latency > +30%).
Ops-Bot: automation suggestion: tenant state machine: READY -> SNAPSHOT -> TRANSFERRING -> VALIDATING -> CUTOVER -> COMPLETED. expose REST hook for portal and CLI. sample: `ri ops tenant migrate --id 42 --to eu-west-2`
Ravi Patel: Proxy rules: add X-Tenant-Residency header (EU_ONLY|RELOCATING|GLOBAL). proxy must reject any non-EU candidate for EU_ONLY tenants with 451 + help link. small pseudo: `if residency==EU_ONLY and candidate not in EU: return 451`
Legal:Ana: Legal requires export manifest with SHA256, timestamped attestation, and a ticket id for deletion. keep audit logs for 90 days post-transfer. add retention-lock to prevent accidental wipe.
Mae Chen: Telemetry: residency.evacuate.duration, residency.evacuate.errors, residency.evacuate.rows_mismatch. also keep overlap-read window (2h) so billing/telemetry continuity can be verified.
Ravi Patel: Session and cache note: drain sessions, prime KV on target via replay of last-24h prefixes, then cutover writes. ensure we don't serve stale cache on target.
Mae Chen: I'll open the runbook PR with checklist and canary play. Ravi, can you own proxy guard + unit tests? Ops-Bot will emit a slack alert when canary starts (#eu-evac-canary).
Ravi Patel: I'll take proxy. thanks. short action items: runbook PR, proxy guard, legal attestation template, canary schedule.
Mae Chen: Closing: keep all steps auditable and scriptable. we'll reconvene after canary results.
